description: This file defines the API for the mirror module in a Realtek switch driver, including function declarations, enums, and documentation for mirror configuration such as port-based mirroring, port isolation, VLAN leaky, port override, and keep modes.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_set
methods.description: Sets port mirroring configuration, specifying the monitor port and mirrored port masks for RX and TX.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portBased_get
methods.description: Retrieves current port mirroring settings, including monitor port and mirrored port masks.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_set
methods.description: Configures mirror port isolation to prevent normal forwarding packets to the mirror port.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_portIso_get
methods.description: Gets current mirror port isolation status.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_set
methods.description: Enables or disables VLAN leaky feature for mirror VLAN.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_vlanLeaky_get
methods.description: Retrieves VLAN leaky configuration status for mirror VLAN.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_set
methods.description: Sets leaky feature for mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_isolationLeaky_get
methods.description: Gets configuration for leaky feature of mirror port isolation.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_set
methods.description: Sets how mirror packets are kept, such as VLAN follow or original.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_keep_get
methods.description: Gets current mirror packet keep mode.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_set
methods.description: Configures port override behavior for mirror and normal packets output.

methods.name: rtk_mirror_override_get
methods.description: Gets current port mirror override configuration.
